title: The Arrival of the Spelljammer
description: A massive flaming celestial vessel crashes into the Sunken Reach.

title: Council Action: Quarantine the Reach
description: The Discord Server voted to fund an immediate military blockade instead of sending researchers.

title: Session 12: Piercing the Line
description: The Open Eyes party smuggles a dying elven scholar across the naval checkpoint.

title: Session 13: Ash and Embers
description: The military camp is struck by an environmental radiation pulse coming from the crash center.
